en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
was: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nesibhakabhaka.
rewrite: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nditsho nesibhakabhaka.

judge.reason: Stiff: 'Akukho mpazamo namhlanje' says no mistakes happened rather than the day making none; a speaker would say 'Nditsho nesibhakabhaka' for 'Sky included'.
judge.rewrite: Usuku lwanamhlanje alukenzi mpazamo nanye ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nditsho nesibhakabhaka.

bt.bt: There is no mistake today up to now. Even the sky.

en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
was: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali.
rewrite: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asinyatheli nokunyathela iipedali.

judge.reason: 'Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali' says kicking, not pedalling; a speaker would say 'asinyatheli nokunyathela iipedali'.
judge.rewrite: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asinyatheli nokunyathela iipedali.

why: checker triage-high 0.7: 'Asinyatheli' — not found in any external source; closest attested: 'akunyatheli' (1× leipzig, distance 2) | 'iipedali' — not found in any external source; closest attested: 'iimedali' (1× wiki, distance 1)

bt.bt: A small dust storm walks in front of him. It does not even step on the pedals.

en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
was: Isiqwengana sokugqibela seenkuni sisigqibo, asiyonto nje ekhoyo.
rewrite: Isikhuni sokugqibela sisigqibo, asiyonto nje yokubalwa.

judge.reason: A log is 'isikhuni', not 'isiqwengana seenkuni' (a piece of wood); 'asiyonto nje ekhoyo' loses the inventory idea, 'yokubalwa' (to be counted) keeps it.
judge.rewrite: Isikhuni sokugqibela sisigqibo, asiyonto nje yokubalwa.

bt.bt: The last log is a decision, not just something to be counted.

en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
was: Inyanga ingemva kwelifu, inja isestoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.
rewrite: Inyanga isemva kwelifu, inja ikwi-stoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.

judge.reason: 'ingemva kwelifu' is wrong: behind a cloud is 'isemva kwelifu'; 'isestoep' reads better as 'ikwi-stoep'. The church-service turn lands.
judge.rewrite: Inyanga isemva kwelifu, inja ikwi-stoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.

bt.bt: The moon is behind the cloud, the dog is on the stoep. The Sunday service is over.

en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
was: Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku yenza zonke izitrato zibe ziindawo zokwenza ifilimu.
rewrite: Ngentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku, inkungu yenza zonke izitalato zibe yiseti yefilimu.

judge.reason: Long and stiff: 'Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku' stacks possessives, and the house form is 'izitalato', not 'izitrato'.
judge.rewrite: Ngentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku, inkungu yenza zonke izitalato zibe yiseti yefilimu.

bt.bt: At ten o'clock at night, the fog turns all the streets into a film set.

en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
was: Ihlathi lithe cwaka namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.
rewrite: IBushveld ikwi-silent mode namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.

judge.reason: 'Ihlathi' means forest, not bushveld, and 'lithe cwaka' drops the phone 'silent mode' joke; people code-switch both here.
judge.rewrite: IBushveld ikwi-silent mode namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.

bt.bt: The Bushveld is in silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.

en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
was: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle bavumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle zivumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.

judge.reason: Agreement: sky and sea joined take 'zivumelene', not the human 'bavumelene'; the rest reads well.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle zivumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.

bt.bt: The sky and the sea agree in colour this morning. It is not an interesting colour.

en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
was: Icala elinesithunzi lebala lilizwe lalo ngokwalo.
rewrite: Icala lebala elinomthunzi linemozulu yalo ngokwalo.

judge.reason: Shade is 'umthunzi' ('isithunzi' is shadow or dignity), the possessive order is awkward, and 'lilizwe lalo' (its own country) loses the climate; 'linemozulu yalo' keeps it.
judge.rewrite: Icala lebala elinomthunzi linemozulu yalo ngokwalo.

bt.bt: The shaded side of the field has its own weather.

en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.
was: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele.
rewrite: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele nemvume.

judge.reason: 'ingakhange icele' leaves 'cela' hanging with no object and drops 'even'; a speaker would say it came without even asking permission.
judge.rewrite: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele nemvume.

bt.bt: The [?yeziko] weather has arrived without even asking permission.

en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
was: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zizithathela indawo.
rewrite: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane zokuhombisa ziyazibambela.

judge.reason: 'zizithathela indawo' reads as the lights taking a place for themselves, not standing in for the stars; 'izibane ezincinci' (small lights) loses the fairy lights. 'ziyazibambela' says covering for them.
judge.rewrite: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane zokuhombisa ziyazibambela.

bt.bt: Half of the stars are behind clouds. The decorative lights cover for them.

en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
was: Ndilibale ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ngobusuku. Bonke.
rewrite: Ndisoloko ndilibala ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ubusuku. Ngabunye.

judge.reason: 'Ngobusuku. Bonke.' reassembles as 'ubusuku bonke' = the whole night, not every night; the habitual is also lost in the one-off past 'Ndilibale'.
judge.rewrite: Ndisoloko ndilibala ukuvula i-electric blanket kwangethuba. Qho. Ebusuku.

bt.bt: I always forget to switch on the electric blanket early. Every. Single. Night.

en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
was: IDolophu enoBubele ayizange icele ukuba yiDolophu enoMoya, kodwa ke.
rewrite: IGqeberha, i-Friendly City, ayizange icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa ke.

judge.reason: 'IDolophu enoBubele' is a translated nickname a reader won't recognise as Gqeberha; people keep 'Friendly City' / 'Windy City' as loans and name the place.
judge.rewrite: IGqeberha, i-Friendly City, ayizange icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa ke.

bt.bt: Gqeberha, the Friendly City, did not ask to be the Windy City, but there it is.

en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
was: Ilaphu letafile li-ayiniwe kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
rewrite: Ilaphu letafile li-ayinwe, lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.

judge.reason: 'li-ayiniwe' is a malformed passive of the loan 'ayina' (iron) — the form is 'li-ayinwe'; 'kwaye' is stiff here.
judge.rewrite: Ilaphu letafile li-ayinwe, lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.

bt.bt: The tablecloth is ironed, ready for tomorrow's work.

en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
was: Amafu ambalwa eze kubukela. Nawo akabaleki.
rewrite: Amafu ambalwa afike ezokubukela. Nawo akabaleki.

judge.reason: 'eze kubukela' is a participial/subjunctive form, not a main-clause past; a speaker would say 'afike ezokubukela'.
judge.rewrite: Amafu ambalwa afike ezokubukela. Nawo akabaleki.

bt.bt: A few clouds came to watch. Even they are not running away.

en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.
was: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sayinwa ngumkhenkce.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sicocekile, sibanda njengomkhenkce.

judge.reason: 'sayinwa' reads as 'it was signed' (sayina = sign), not ironed; 'ice-pressed' does not carry — say freshly washed, clean and ice-cold.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sicocekile, sibanda njengomkhenkce.

bt.bt: Today's sky: freshly washed, clean, cold as ice.

en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
was: Inyanga ikhanya kancinci ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko asinako oko.
rewrite: Inyanga ikwi-dimmer ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko sona asinayo loo setting.

judge.reason: Correct but flat: 'ikhanya kancinci' drops the dimmer image and 'asinako oko' turns the punchline vague; urban speakers would keep the loan words, as the natives kept 'ultra mode' and 'vibe'.
judge.rewrite: Inyanga ikwi-dimmer ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko sona asinayo loo setting.

bt.bt: The moon is on dimmer tonight. The security light does not have that setting.

en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
was: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zizathu. UMvulo uphantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.
rewrite: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zaba. NguMvulo phantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.

judge.reason: 'izizathu' means reasons, not excuses; the confirmed lines say 'akukho zaba'. 'NguMvulo phantsi' reads more naturally than 'UMvulo uphantsi'.
judge.rewrite: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zaba. NguMvulo phantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.

bt.bt: No shadows, no shining, no [?zaba]. It is Monday under a Tupperware lid.

en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.
was: Ukubona: akukho. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.
rewrite: Ukubonakala: zero. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.

judge.reason: 'Ukubona: akukho' (seeing: there is none) is stiff; visibility is 'ukubonakala', and people just say 'zero' as in the confirmed 'iku zero'.
judge.rewrite: Ukubonakala: zero. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.

bt.bt: Visibility: zero. Mood: calm, surprisingly.

en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.
was: Umphefumlo omnye womoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke liyimbongi.
rewrite: Uphefumla kanye umoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke libe yimbongi.

judge.reason: 'Umphefumlo omnye' reads as 'one soul', not one breath; a speaker would use the verb 'uphefumla'. 'Imbongi' is a great fit for poet.
judge.rewrite: Uphefumla kanye umoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke libe yimbongi.

bt.bt: You breathe in the rain wind just once, and suddenly the whole country becomes a poet.

en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
was: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona.
rewrite: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyo yodwa ene-hairstyle eyenzelwe wona.

judge.reason: 'Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona' is stiff and translated; 'inwele' is a single human hair, and the hairstyle joke is lost.
judge.rewrite: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyo yodwa ene-hairstyle eyenzelwe wona.

bt.bt: The dog loves this wind. It is the only one with a hairstyle made for it.

en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
was: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Inyani, liyakufanele.
rewrite: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Ngenene, liyifanele.

judge.reason: 'liyakufanele' means 'it suits you', not 'it deserves it' ('liyifanele', as in the confirmed 'Uyifanele'); 'honestly' is 'Ngenene' in the confirmed lines.
judge.rewrite: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Ngenene, liyifanele.

bt.bt: The sun takes a long time going down to set. Truly, it deserves it.

en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
was: Yithi inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise ibraai yangoMgqibelo.
rewrite: Thetha inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise i-braai yangoMgqibelo.

judge.reason: 'Yithi inyani' is unusual; a speaker says 'Thetha inyani' for 'be honest'. The rest is natural.
judge.rewrite: Thetha inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise i-braai yangoMgqibelo.

bt.bt: Tell the truth: you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.

en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
was: Onke amacebo ngoku afuduselwe 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.
rewrite: Onke amacebo ahlehliselwe ngokusemthethweni 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.

judge.reason: 'afuduselwe' means relocated (moving house), not postponed ('ahlehliselwe'); 'officially' dropped. 'Hayi bo' is a good fit for 'Shame'.
judge.rewrite: Onke amacebo ahlehliselwe ngokusemthethweni 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.

bt.bt: All plans have been officially postponed until 'it clears'. Which will never happen. Oh no.

en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
was: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka bangwevu ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.
rewrite: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka zimpunga ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.

judge.reason: 'bangwevu' uses the human class-2 concord and 'ngwevu' is grey hair; sea and sky take 'zi-' and the colour is 'mpunga' (as in the confirmed 'Mhlawumbi mpunga').
judge.rewrite: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka zimpunga ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.

bt.bt: The sea and the sky are equally grey. Only the bridge lights are trying.

en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
was: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akuze kubande ngoku bayavuma.
rewrite: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akusoze kubande sebeyavuma ukuba kuyabanda.

judge.reason: bayavuma has nothing to admit: a speaker says what they admit (bayavuma ukuba kuyabanda, as in the confirmed Capetonians line); akusoze is the everyday 'never', and ngoku sits awkwardly mid-clause.
judge.rewrite: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akusoze kubande sebeyavuma ukuba kuyabanda.

bt.bt: Even those who swear it will never get cold admit once it is cold.

en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
was: Ilanga alizukuza kujonga ukukhazimla namhlanje. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.
rewrite: Namhlanje ilanga aliyi kujonga ukukhazimla kwemoto. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.

judge.reason: alizukuza kujonga doubles the future marker (a speaker says aliyi kujonga / alizokujonga), and ukukhazimla alone loses that it is the car's shine being inspected.
judge.rewrite: Namhlanje ilanga aliyi kujonga ukukhazimla kwemoto. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.

bt.bt: Today the sun will not look at the shine of the car. The car has no problem with that.

en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
was: Ungwevu wempelaveki: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto konke konke.
rewrite: Impelaveki empunga: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto kwaphela.

judge.reason: ungwevu as a noun for 'greyness' is not how people say grey (natives used mpunga), and konke konke reads isiZulu; isiXhosa says kwaphela, as in the confirmed 'ukungenzi nto kwaphela'.
judge.rewrite: Impelaveki empunga: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto kwaphela.

bt.bt: The grey weekend: official permission to do nothing at all.

en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
was: Ithafa lonke ngathi umbala uthotyiwe. Iigusha zibalwa ngendlela efanayo noko.
rewrite: Ithafa lonke libonakala ngathi umbala wehlisiwe. Inani leegusha alitshintshi noko.

judge.reason: umbala uthotyiwe is a calque of 'turned down' (thoba = lower/humble), and zibalwa ngendlela efanayo says the sheep are counted the same way, not that the count is unchanged.
judge.rewrite: Ithafa lonke libonakala ngathi umbala wehlisiwe. Inani leegusha alitshintshi noko.

bt.bt: The whole plateau looks as if the colour has been turned down. The number of sheep has not changed, though.

en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
was: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku nengqele enkulu.
rewrite: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku, kubande ngathi kuseNorth Pole.

judge.reason: bubusuku nengqele enkulu is clumsy (night 'and big cold') and drops the North Pole image that carries the joke; the place name can stay as a code-switch.
judge.rewrite: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku, kubande ngathi kuseNorth Pole.

bt.bt: Look quickly. In ten minutes it will be night, as cold as the North Pole.

en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
was: Ilaphu letafile lentaba lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.
rewrite: Ilaphu letafile lentaba ligqume isiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.

judge.reason: lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha means 'more by half / above by a half', not that the tablecloth only half covers the mountain; the Monday half fits.
judge.rewrite: Ilaphu letafile lentaba ligqume isiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.

bt.bt: The mountain's tablecloth covers only half. It is Monday, nobody is fully dressed.

en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
was: Ifama isekhona. Sikholelwa nje kwilizwi lomnye nomnye.
rewrite: Ifama isekhona. Sithembele nje kwinto esixelelana yona.

judge.reason: kwilizwi lomnye nomnye is a word-for-word 'each other's word' and sounds translated; a speaker would say they just trust what they tell each other.
judge.rewrite: Ifama isekhona. Sithembele nje kwinto esixelelana yona.

bt.bt: The farm is still there. We just rely on what we tell each other.

en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
was: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Hayi.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Nakanye.

judge.reason: sizigqumile and iingubo zakho ziyakulinda are good; Hayi answers 'Coincidence?' flatly where the English says 'Never' — nakanye carries it.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Nakanye.

why: checker triage-high 0.55: 'sizigqumile' — not found in any external source

bt.bt: The sky has covered itself. Your clothes are waiting for you. Does it happen? Not once.

en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
was: Izilwanyana zasendle azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azikhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
rewrite: Iiblesbok azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azifaki zikhalazo. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.

judge.reason: izilwanyana zasendle flattens the blesbok into 'wild animals' and loses the SA detail — keep the loan; 'file no complaints' reads better with the confirmed 'fake isikhalazo' shape.
judge.rewrite: Iiblesbok azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azifaki zikhalazo. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.

bt.bt: The blesbok do not wear scarves and do not lodge complaints. We could learn something. We will not learn, but we could.

en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
was: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: ngwevu, icocekile, ayixeli nto.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: empunga, ecocekileyo, kwaye asixeli nto.

judge.reason: ayixeli nto agrees with the suit, not the sky; the English has the sky giving nothing away — asixeli nto, and a relative for the suit's colour.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: empunga, ecocekileyo, kwaye asixeli nto.

bt.bt: The sky is wearing an interview suit: grey, clean, and says nothing.

en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
was: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayidingi mvume yelanga.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayifuni mvume yelanga.

judge.reason: ayidingi reads isiZulu for 'need'; an isiXhosa speaker says ayifuni. The rest (isikolo siphumile, iijezi zinxitywe) is natural.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayifuni mvume yelanga.

bt.bt: The sky is grey, jerseys are on, school is out. The weekend does not need the sun's permission.

en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
was: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba asiyiyo imozulu. Umlilo uhlala uvutha.
rewrite: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba ayisosiganeko semozulu. Umlilo usavutha.

judge.reason: asiyiyo imozulu says 'it is not the weather' and does not agree with ilifu; 'weather event' is isiganeko semozulu, in the confirmed 'ayisosiphelo sehlabathi' shape.
judge.rewrite: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba ayisosiganeko semozulu. Umlilo usavutha.

bt.bt: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire is still burning.

en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
was: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ubusuku bufikile noko.
rewrite: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ukuhlwa kufikile noko.

judge.reason: ngokuhlwanje is not the everyday 'tonight' (ngokuhlwa namhlanje / namhlanje), and ubusuku is night where the English says the evening showed up.
judge.rewrite: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka namhlanje. Kodwa ukuhlwa kufikile noko.

bt.bt: The sunset was quiet tonight. Evening has come all the same.

en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
was: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kungwevu olukhanyayo saya kungwevu olumnyama. Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka besingwevu kancinci, ngoku singwevu kakhulu. Ngumboniso wonke lowo.

judge.reason: ungwevu olukhanyayo / olumnyama is laboured, and Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo says 'that was all the shows' (plural); a speaker says ngumboniso wonke lowo.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka besingwevu kancinci, ngoku singwevu kakhulu. Ngumboniso wonke lowo.

bt.bt: The sky was a little grey, now it is very grey. That is the whole show.

en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
was: Umoya omncinci usashushu ngeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
rewrite: Umoya usafudumele nangeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

judge.reason: usashushu says the breeze is still hot; warm is usafudumele. The sea leaving the heater on all night is good.
judge.rewrite: Umoya usafudumele nangeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

bt.bt: The wind is still warm at this time. The sea leaves the heater on all night.

en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
was: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwabadlali bamaza. Ithi: hambani.
rewrite: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwee-surfer. Ithi: ngenani emanzini.

judge.reason: 'abadlali bamaza' is a translated coinage for surfers (people just say ii-surfer), and 'hambani' reads as 'go away' rather than 'get in the water'.
judge.rewrite: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwee-surfer. Ithi: ngenani emanzini.

bt.bt: The flag announces the weather before the surfers do. It says: get into the water.

en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.
was: Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.
rewrite: Ogqibela ukudlula makavale isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.

judge.reason: 'Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala' is stiff and states a fact; the house rule reads naturally as 'Ogqibela ukudlula makavale'.
judge.rewrite: Ogqibela ukudlula makavale isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.

bt.bt: The last one to pass must close the gate. Even if nobody sees it.

en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
was: Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Iinkomo zamkela oko.
rewrite: Ngokuhlwanje isibane seshedi sithatha indawo yelanga elitshonayo. Iinkomo ziyavuma, nangona kungafani.

judge.reason: 'Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga' is a word-for-word copula, and 'zamkela oko' drops the downgrade so the turn goes flat.
judge.rewrite: Ngokuhlwanje isibane seshedi sithatha indawo yelanga elitshonayo. Iinkomo ziyavuma, nangona kungafani.

bt.bt: Tonight the shed light takes the place of the setting sun. The cows agree, though it is not the same.

en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
was: Isekude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amahlanu, kodwa istoep sele sigcwele.
rewrite: Imvula isekude nge-50 km, kodwa i-stoep sele igcwele.

judge.reason: 'Isekude' has no subject a reader can find (what is far away?), and the spelled-out number is stiff where people say 50 km.
judge.rewrite: Isaqhwithi sisekude nge-50 km, kodwa i-stoep sele igcwele.

bt.bt: The rain is still 50 km away, but the stoep is already full.

en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
was: Imozulu entle kangaka yeyokubolekwa. Umoya wasempuma-mzantsi ugcina iirisithi.
rewrite: Imozulu entle kangaka ibolekiwe nje. Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma ugcina iirisithi.

judge.reason: 'wasempuma-mzantsi' is back to front; the natives write the Southeaster as 'Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma'. 'yeyokubolekwa' is a bit stiff next to 'ibolekiwe nje'.
judge.rewrite: Imozulu entle kangaka ibolekiwe nje. Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma ugcina iirisithi.

bt.bt: Such lovely weather is only borrowed. The south-east wind keeps the receipts.

en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
was: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi konke. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.
rewrite: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi kwaphela. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.

judge.reason: 'ungahambi konke' is wrong: 'konke' means 'all'; 'not at all' is 'kwaphela'.
judge.rewrite: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi kwaphela. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.

bt.bt: Go now or don't go at all. The Lowveld gives you time until seven o'clock.

en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.
was: Iindaba ezintsha: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.
rewrite: Iindaba ezishushu: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.

judge.reason: 'Iindaba ezintsha' is just 'new news'; the breaking-news register that makes the joke is 'Iindaba ezishushu'.
judge.rewrite: Iindaba ezishushu: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.

bt.bt: Hot news: the pools are open now.

en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
was: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwindawo yeziqhamo namhlanje. Ipholisa simahla, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.
rewrite: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwisitali seziqhamo namhlanje. I-aircon ifakiwe, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.

judge.reason: Agreement slip: 'Ipholisa' does not agree with umoya (u-); and the air-con joke is lost where people simply say i-aircon.
judge.rewrite: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwisitali seziqhamo namhlanje. I-aircon ifakiwe, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.

bt.bt: A small wind is working at the fruit stall today. Aircon installed, no extra money.

en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.
was: UGqirha uhamba ejonga kusasa. Akufuneki kubhukisha, ngelishwa.
rewrite: I-Cape Doctor ijikeleza kusasa. Akufuneki ubhukishe, ngelishwa.

judge.reason: 'UGqirha' alone reads as a real doctor, not the wind; the natives keep the name 'I-Cape Doctor'. 'uhamba ejonga' is a loose gloss of rounds.
judge.rewrite: I-Cape Doctor ijikeleza kusasa. Akufuneki ubhukishe, ngelishwa.

why: back-translation drifts (0.45): "The Cape Doctor is going around tomorrow. You need not book, unfortunately." — "kusasa" reads as tomorrow; English says morning rounds

bt.bt: The Cape Doctor is going around tomorrow. You need not book, unfortunately.

en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
was: Ungwevu kusasa. Mayihlale nje kancinci, njengeti.
rewrite: Isibhakabhaka singwevu kusasa. Njengeti, siyeke nje sihlale kancinci.

judge.reason: 'Ungwevu kusasa' has no clear subject (reads like a grey-haired person), and 'mayihlale' points at nothing; the Earl Grey pun does not carry, so name the sky.
judge.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka singwevu kusasa. Njengeti, siyeke nje sihlale kancinci.

why: back-translation drifts (0.45): "The sky is grey tomorrow. Like tea, it just stops and sits a little." — "kusasa" reads as tomorrow; English says early grey

bt.bt: The sky is grey tomorrow. Like tea, it just stops and sits a little.

en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
was: Umoya omncinci uthutha i-jacaranda iye kwesinye isitrato, intyatyambo ngentyatyambo. Istoep siyavuma.
rewrite: Umoya omncinci uthutha iintyatyambo ze-jacaranda uziyisa kwesinye isitalato, nganye nganye. I-stoep iyavuma.

judge.reason: 'uthutha i-jacaranda' says the wind carries the whole tree, not its flowers; 'isitrato' should be the usual 'isitalato'; the stoep reads better as 'I-stoep iyavuma'.
judge.rewrite: Umoya omncinci uthutha iintyatyambo ze-jacaranda uziyisa kwesinye isitalato, nganye nganye. I-stoep iyavuma.

bt.bt: A small wind carries jacaranda flowers to another street, one by one. The stoep agrees.

en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
was: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Yintshayelelo leyo.
rewrite: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Leyo yi-trailer.

judge.reason: First sentence is natural; 'intshayelelo' (preface) loses the film-trailer joke, and people simply say 'trailer'.
judge.rewrite: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Leyo yi-trailer.

bt.bt: Highveld rain you smell before you see it. That is the trailer.

en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
was: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Yile ndlela uMvulo ozolileyo ukhangeleka ngayo apha.
rewrite: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Kwi-deck, nguMvulo ozolileyo lo.

judge.reason: Second sentence is long and translated ('Yile ndlela ... ukhangeleka ngayo apha') and drops the deck; a speaker would say it shorter.
judge.rewrite: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Kwi-deck, nguMvulo ozolileyo lo.

bt.bt: The flags are stretched, the wine is held firmly. On the deck, it is a calm Monday.

en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
was: Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga asiyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Lichiza.
rewrite: Ii-sundowners aziyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Ngamayeza.

judge.reason: 'Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga' is a stiff calque; speakers say 'ii-sundowners', the way natives kept 'braai'.
judge.rewrite: Ii-sundowners aziyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Ngamayeza.

bt.bt: Sundowners are not a luxury in the Lowveld. They are medicine.

en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
was: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, inyani, kubanda ngakumbi.
rewrite: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, ngenene, kubanda ngakumbi.

judge.reason: 'inyani' on its own does not work as 'honestly'; the app's word is 'ngenene'.
judge.rewrite: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, ngenene, kubanda ngakumbi.

bt.bt: We sit outside on the lawn because inside, truly, it is colder.

en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
was: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nesithunzi. Ihlala khona.
rewrite: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ayisuki apho.

judge.reason: Shade is 'umthunzi' ('isithunzi' is a shadow); 'Ihlala khona' reads 'it lives there' rather than 'it won't budge'.
judge.rewrite: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ayisuki apho.

bt.bt: The dog has found exactly the border between sun and shade. It does not leave there.

en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
was: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
rewrite: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. I-umpire ayizange ibe nelanga emehlweni.

judge.reason: 'Usompempe' is the football referee, a cricket umpire is just 'umpire'; 'afinyeze amehlo' for squinting is not a sure phrase, so say it plainly.
judge.rewrite: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. I-umpire ayizange ibe nelanga emehlweni.

bt.bt: There is not a single shade on the field all day. The umpire never had the sun in his eyes.

en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
was: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajiwuzela. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.
rewrite: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajinga. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.

judge.reason: 'ziyajiwuzela' is not a word I can confirm; swaying lights are 'ziyajinga'. The rest reads well.
judge.rewrite: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajinga. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.

bt.bt: All the lights on the string are twinkling. Saturday night has rhythm, just a little.

en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
was: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uzibonakalisa nje kumntwana.
rewrite: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uziqhayisa nje kumntwana.

judge.reason: 'uzibonakalisa' means 'shows itself / appears', not 'shows off'; showing off is 'uyaziqhayisa'.
judge.rewrite: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uziqhayisa nje kumntwana.

bt.bt: The sheets are already dry. Now a small wind is just showing off to the child.

en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.
was: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungalimbi. Kugqibelele.
rewrite: Ikhephu likufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kodwa likude kangangokuba akuyi kulisusa ngefosholo. Kugqibelele.

judge.reason: 'ngokwaneleyo ukuba' twice is a stiff calque, and the 'li' object never names the snow, so a reader cannot tell what is being admired or dug.
judge.rewrite: Ikhephu likufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kodwa likude kangangokuba akuyi kulisusa ngefosholo. Kugqibelele.

why: checker triage-high 0.6: 'kulisusa' — not found in any external source; closest attested: 'kuyisusa' (1× leipzig, distance 1)

bt.bt: The snow is near enough that you can admire it, but far enough that you will not clear it with a shovel. Perfect.

en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.
was: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linuka kamnandi.
rewrite: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linevumba elimnandi.

judge.reason: 'linuka' in isiXhosa leans to 'stinks', so 'linuka kamnandi' jars; a speaker says 'linevumba elimnandi'.
judge.rewrite: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linevumba elimnandi.

bt.bt: A grey day is a baking day. Someone's kitchen already smells good.

en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
was: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, kunye nebhalkoni.
rewrite: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, nebhalkoni isakhanya.

judge.reason: 'liphume emsebenzini' (knocked off) is a good idiom, but 'kunye nebhalkoni' tacked on the end reads translated; a speaker would give the balcony its own verb.
judge.rewrite: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, nebhalkoni isakhanya.

bt.bt: The sun has knocked off from work. The clouds are still shining, and the balcony is still shining.

en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
was: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda.
rewrite: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ayinangxaki yokulinda.

judge.reason: 'Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda' is stiff (literal 'is happy to wait'); a speaker would say it has no problem waiting.
judge.rewrite: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ayinangxaki yokulinda.

why: checker triage-high 0.5: 'ayayidlulisana' — not found in any external source | 'Ibhalkoni' — not found in any external source; closest attested: 'ibhaloni' (0× kaikki, distance 1)

bt.bt: The clouds pass the moon along to each other. The balcony has no problem waiting.

en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
was: Uphefumla ngathi yinamba enomlilo, umbono ngathi liphupha.
rewrite: Uphefumla umsi ngathi yidragon, kodwa imbonakalo intle ngathi liphupha.

judge.reason: 'inamba enomlilo' pictures a fire-snake, not a dragon's misty breath, and 'umbono' leans to opinion/vision; 'imbonakalo' is the view.
judge.rewrite: Uphefumla umsi ngathi yidragon, kodwa imbonakalo intle ngathi liphupha.

bt.bt: You breathe out smoke like a dragon, but the view is beautiful like a dream.

en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
was: Umoya omncinci uthwala umsi usiwa ezantsi kwesitrato. Isitrato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.
rewrite: Umoya uthwala umsi uwusa ezantsi kwesitalato. Isitalato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.

judge.reason: 'umsi usiwa' is the passive (being taken) where it should be 'uwusa' (taking it); 'isitrato' is spelt 'isitalato' in the app's confirmed lines.
judge.rewrite: Umoya uthwala umsi uwusa ezantsi kwesitalato. Isitalato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.

bt.bt: The wind carries smoke and takes it down the street. The whole street knows what is being eaten this evening.

en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
was: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iimpahla ezine nomoya omhle.
rewrite: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: luhlobo olugqobhoza iimpahla ezine ozinxibileyo, nemood yakho emnandi.

judge.reason: 'lolo hlobo lugqobhoza' needs the relative ('luhlobo olugqobhoza'), and 'nomoya omhle' reads as 'a nice wind' in a weather line, not a good mood.
judge.rewrite: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: luhlobo olugqobhoza iimpahla ezine ozinxibileyo, nemood yakho emnandi.

bt.bt: The wet sea cold: the kind that pierces the four layers of clothes you are wearing, and your good mood.

en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
was: Isithunzi sihamba imigca ngemigca. Siyahlola.
rewrite: Isithunzi sihamba umgca ngomgca. Siyahlola.

judge.reason: Row by row is 'umgca ngomgca'; the plural 'imigca ngemigca' sounds off. 'Siyahlola' lands well.
judge.rewrite: Isithunzi sihamba umgca ngomgca. Siyahlola.

bt.bt: The shadow walks line by line. It is inspecting.

en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
was: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli konke konke.
rewrite: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli nakancinci.

judge.reason: 'konke konke' for 'at all' reads isiZulu-flavoured; isiXhosa says 'nakancinci' or 'tu'.
judge.rewrite: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli nakancinci.

bt.bt: You can see the cold coming. It does not hide at all.

en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
was: Ababaleki bango-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.
rewrite: Abantu ababaleka ngo-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.

judge.reason: 'Ababaleki' commonly reads as refugees/fugitives; say the people who run at 5:30.
judge.rewrite: Abantu ababaleka ngo-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.

bt.bt: People who run at 5:30 are not tougher than us. They are just [?krelekrele] more.

en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.
was: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ibhityileyo.
rewrite: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ebhityileyo.

judge.reason: Relative concord slip: 'ibhatyi ibhityileyo' should be 'ebhityileyo' (thin jacket); otherwise the triplet works.
judge.rewrite: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ebhityileyo.

bt.bt: No wind, no clouds, no reason for this thin jacket.

en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.
was: Kumanqanaba amadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisipho sasimahla.
rewrite: Cheers kumadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisiselo sasimahla.

judge.reason: 'Kumanqanaba amadama!' does not read as a toast, and 'sisipho sasimahla' (free gift) loses the round-on-the-house drink.
judge.rewrite: Cheers kumadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisiselo sasimahla.

bt.bt: Cheers to the dams! All heavy rain is a free drink.

en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
was: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.
rewrite: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingama-30, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.

judge.reason: Long and stiff; 'ngokuhlwanje' is unsure, and the number reads easier as 'ezingama-30'.
judge.rewrite: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingama-30, kwaye ebusuku namhlanje bakubona kancinci ngakumbi.

bt.bt: The nearest neighbours are 30 kilometres away, and tonight they see you even less.

en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
was: Impahla bekufanele ingene kwiiyure ezidlulileyo. Umoya omncinci uvote ukuba ihlale.
rewrite: Impahla bekufanele ingeniswe kudala. Umoya uvotele ukuba ihlale phandle.

judge.reason: Washing does not come in by itself: 'ingeniswe' (be brought in); 'kwiiyure ezidlulileyo' is stiff where a speaker says 'kudala'; 'uvotele ... ihlale phandle' finishes the turn.
judge.rewrite: Impahla bekufanele ingeniswe kudala. Umoya uvotele ukuba ihlale phandle.

bt.bt: The washing should have been brought in long ago. The wind voted for it to stay outside.

en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
was: Iinkomo zisekhaya phambi kokuba umbala uphele. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.
rewrite: Iinkomo sele zisekhaya phambi kokuba kuhlwe. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.

judge.reason: 'phambi kokuba umbala uphele' (before the colour ends) is opaque; 'phambi kokuba kuhlwe' is how a speaker says it. 'ICawa iphela ngexesha' is a lovely Sunday/church double.
judge.rewrite: Iinkomo sele zisekhaya phambi kokuba kuhlwe. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.

why: checker triage-high 0.5: 'iphela' means 'cockroach' — nothing in the English source; it is 3 letters from 'ibala', the usual word for 'colour'

bt.bt: The cattle are already home before evening. Church ends exactly on time.

en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
was: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka ngokuqinisekileyo iceba into.
rewrite: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka — kucacile ukuba iceba into.

judge.reason: 'ngokuqinisekileyo' is bookish mid-sentence; a speaker would say 'kucacile ukuba'. 'iceba into' is right.
judge.rewrite: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka — kucacile ukuba iceba into.

bt.bt: Weather that behaves so well: clearly it is planning something.

en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
was: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa ngumkhenkce kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.
rewrite: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa yingqele kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.

judge.reason: 'ukubanjwa ngumkhenkce' (caught by ice) is literal; 'ukubanjwa yingqele' is the natural way to say frostbite.
judge.rewrite: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa yingqele kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.

bt.bt: Highveld winter: being burnt by the sun and caught by the cold can happen on one day.

en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
was: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya omncinci ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nootitshala.
rewrite: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nditsho nootitshala.

judge.reason: The tag 'Nootitshala.' alone is abrupt; 'Nditsho nootitshala' is the natural 'teachers included'.
judge.rewrite: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nditsho nootitshala.

bt.bt: It is break time, and the wind fixes everybody's hair. Even the teachers.
